summary: I confirm the fix. On a current server, a client boot or reconnect no longer lists devices and no longer opens /ws/device, and the server spawns no Xcode or simctl process on connect. Connections only register their device client. The device event stream starts once a thread view or the simulator pane holds the device runtime (ensureDeviceRuntime, released 60 s after the last holder lets go), and it runs over the main /ws socket, which now serves the device RPCs. Subscribing only adds a manager.onEvent listener. The only inventory read left is SimulatorPanel's refresh, and the pane mounts only while the simulator tab is active. That read is cheaper too: xcode-select and xcodebuild results are cached and shared, and a 2 s reuse window gives one simctl list per read instead of two. No other client or server path runs simctl, xcode-select or xcodebuild on connect.

evidence.note: The connection only calls registerDeviceConnection. reconnect() at :360-370 only calls deviceBinding?.reconnecting() and lists nothing.
bindDeviceConnection subscribes to events only. It has no list or refreshInventory call.
registerDeviceConnection binds only while something retains the runtime. ensureDeviceRuntime is ref-counted and unbinds after DEVICE_RUNTIME_IDLE_MS = 60 s.
This hook holds the runtime. Its only callers are SimulatorPanel.tsx:166, ChatThreadRouteView.tsx:128 and DraftChatThreadRouteView.tsx:95.

The only client inventory read is a parallel list() + getThreadState(), run on mount or when the generation changes. ThreadWorkspacePanel.tsx:1536-1538 mounts the pane only when activeMode === 'simulator'.
Its getThreadState call runs only when a prompt looks like a device task, never on connect.
/ws serves WsHostedRpcGroup, the app group merged with the device group, using the device layer. /ws/device stays only for older clients.

createDirectDeviceRpcTransport: RPCs and the event stream use the main socket. The dedicated socket opens only for requestBulk (screenshots) or after an 'Unknown request tag' answer, and closes after 60 s idle. A non-retryable stream failure, such as unsupported-platform on Linux, calls onError once and does not loop (wsTransport.ts:381-395).
The primary and saved-environment clients create DeviceWsTransport only inside the lazy openDedicated callback. The hosted path (:959) shares the relay transport.
subscribeEvents only registers manager.onEvent and spawns nothing.
DEVICE_LISTING_REUSE_MS = 2 s, with one shared listing promise. boot re-reads with fresh:true (:518) and shutdown clears the cache (:537).
xcode-select -p is cached for 60 s and xcodebuild -version for 5 min, as shared promises. A non-Xcode path or an unaccepted license is not kept.
Availability probes and discovery are single-flighted per host, so the pane's concurrent list() and getThreadState() share one read.
Tests assert that list is not called on connect, resubscribe or reconnect, plus lazy binding and idle unbind.
Tests cover one simctl run per read, reuse of the toolchain caches, and a fresh listing after boot.

fixDefects: No blocking defect, and nothing brings back the per-connect cost. The auditor's three deviations are accurate: the stream starts on thread-view mount, the reuse window is 2 s rather than 30 s, and a failed listing is reused for 2 s. Two more small notes. (1) A reconnect bumps the device generation twice, once in deviceBinding.reconnecting() (connection.ts:362) and again on the stream's onResubscribe (runtime.ts:35-37). With the simulator pane open, that runs two list() + getThreadState() refreshes. The 2 s listing reuse and HostDeviceBackend single-flight usually merge them into one simctl run on the server. It costs nothing when the pane is closed. (2) The Android backend (AndroidEmulatorBackend.ts:211-341) has no listing cache. availability() is cached for only 5 s, and listDevices() re-runs emulator -list-avds, adb devices -l and two adb calls per running emulator. On hosts with the Android SDK, each pane refresh therefore spawns several adb/emulator processes. That code is unchanged since f1be4abc7 and runs only on pane open, never on connect.
implementationSketch: Optional, low value. (a) Drop the explicit deviceBinding?.reconnecting() bump in connection.ts reconnect(), or skip the onResubscribe bump when a reconnecting() bump has not yet seen a resubscribe, so one reconnect causes one pane refresh. Add a runtime.test.ts case that counts generation bumps per reconnect. (b) Give AndroidEmulatorBackend a short (~2 s) shared-promise listing cache like IosSimulatorBackend.listDevicesUnchecked: let probeAvailability reuse the avds()/running() result, and clear the cache on boot, shutdown and boot-completion. Test with a fake run() counter, as in IosSimulatorBackend.probeCache.test.ts.
